question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Final verification query
WITH peak AS (
  SELECT im.interest_id, im.month_year, im.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rn
  FROM interest_metrics im
  WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL AND im.composition IS NOT NULL
),
peaks_only AS (
  SELECT p.interest_id, p.month_year, p.composition
  FROM peak p
  WHERE p.rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT po.interest_id, po.month_year, po.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY po.composition DESC) as rank_desc,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY po.composition ASC) as rank_asc
  FROM peaks_only po
)
SELECT r.month_year as time, im2.interest_name, r.composition
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im2 ON im2.id = r.interest_id
WHERE r.rank_desc <= 10 OR r.rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC
